title: BG rising or falling fast alarms do not work
body:
Hi,
I'm using Freestyle Libre sensor with blucon reader. The setup is libre + blucon + xdrip+ app + HTC 10 android 8 + LG G watch (w100) with Android Wear 2.0.

So I'm having problems with the alarms. The high or low alarms both show up on the phone and the watch, but the other alarms like BG rising or falling fast do not seem to work. It only worked once when I first set up the whole system and you can see in the screenshot of the events log. For the life of me I don't know what settings I've changed that it stopped working. I've tried reinstalling xdrip+ and reconnecting the blucon but nothing worked.
Not sure if this is a bug or the way of my setup. I'm using the Feb 9th build of the xdrip+. Any help is appreciated. Thanks.

![screenshot_20180211-143918](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/22730103/36077633-25db7d6e-0f65-11e8-9b87-4a24924eb807.png)

comments.body:
I would like to get logs of what happens when there is such an alert.

Can you please do the following:
go to settings->less common settings -> logs->extra tags for logging
And add there: 
BgReadings  AlertBg:v

Once you think that there should be such al alert please send us the logs.

> Can you please do the following: go to settings->less common settings -> logs->extra tags for logging And add there: BgReadings AlertBg:v


In [current master](https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/blob/f98d57bf8b9f3abd3587b03c21a5c51cb420ca8a/app/src/main/java/com/eveningoutpost/dexdrip/Models/BgReading.java#L64-L67) correct logging tag is `BgReading AlertBg:v` (notice 's')
